text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. 
Who will reign as the strongest in Japan? 
The crowd's attention was fixed on that question.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for the race, Duramente was calm. 
Nothing remained of the unsteady girl she once was. 
She was approaching completion as the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
...Have I grown too, I wonder? 
I was thinking that when she said: 
"Entrust it to me"--because that feeling becomes strength.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
What I entrust to her is... 
absolute victory. The strongest run. 
I believe she will show me both.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
As Duramente headed out, Cheval Grand 
threw down a declaration of war. 
At last, the fight for the title of strongest begins.
